intro: The NX Pro Keylock Safe is built to safeguard your treasures with solid steel shooting bolts, a reliable key lock, and an interior carpet for extra care. Your peace of mind, secured.

features.title: Ultimate security with twin solid steel shooting bolts
features.text: Reinforced security that locks your valuables behind twin solid steel bolts, making unauthorized access virtually impossible—because your peace of mind matters.

features.title: Advanced keylock for trusted protection
features.text: Simple, secure, and reliable. The Godrej 6-lever key lock ensures only you have access, offering robust security with an intuitive locking mechanism.

features.title: Mounting & grouting for extra security
features.text: Secure the locker to walls, floors, or shelves using anchor bolts. This added layer of protection keeps your safe firmly in place, resisting tampering and unauthorized removal.

features.title: Tough metal build for unmatched durability
features.text: Small yet mighty. Despite its compact size, this locker offers superior strength and durability, providing reliable, long-lasting protection for your valuables.

features.title: Removable shelf for flexible organization
features.text: Customizable storage that adapts to your needs. Easily adjust the shelf to accommodate taller items, keeping everything neatly organized and easy to access.

features.title: Interior carpet for gentle care
features.text: Protect your delicate items with a soft carpet lining that cushions and prevents scratches, ensuring your valuables remain pristine and secure.

name: Nx Pro 15 Litres Steel Manual Home Locker
